header.title: Learn Sooth Protocol
header.subtitle: "When every participant has aligned incentives, the protocol doesn't need gatekeepers. Truth emerges from the market itself."

steps.title: The Decentralization Thesis
steps.description: Sooth Protocol is designed around one core thesis: **decentralization creates better markets**. Traditional platforms suffer from gatekept creation and centralized resolution. Sooth solves this through three foundational pillars.

steps.title: The Creator
steps.description: Market creation is an **economic game**. Creators deposit capital and become the first LP, permanently aligning their interests with the market's success.

steps.title: The Gaming Trader
steps.description: Early traders receive **LP tokens** for every trade, converting from customers into protocol stakeholders.

steps.title: The Arbitrageur & PvP Trader
steps.description: Sooth operates **dual trading venues** to serve different trader archetypes. Sophisticated traders use the SoothBook for CEX-grade execution.

steps.title: Start Your Journey
steps.description: Sooth's ecosystem is a cooperative network. Which actor role will you play today?

launchpad.title: Launchpad
launchpad.description: Permissionless market creation with creator economics.

example.title: Creator Example
example.text: Carol creates a 50/50 market with a **$693 deposit** (b=$1,000). Volume generates **$150 in fees**. As the 50% LP holder, she earns from every trade. Skewed odds would require a higher deposit.

mechanismSteps: LP tokens minted TO THE TRADER

sellLock.title: 24h Sell Lock
sellLock.description: To prevent hit-and-run extraction, sell proceeds are locked for 24h. They remain spendable for new trades, but can only be withdrawn after the cooldown.

arb.title: The Arbitrageur's Role
arb.description: Arbitrageurs keep prices efficient by bridging the gap between AMM and SoothBook. They buy cheap on one venue and sell expensive on the other.

pvp.title: PvP Conviction
pvp.description: The SoothBook is where conviction meets conviction. No AMM buffer—just peer-to-peer trading. Winners take the loser's stake with zero LP spread extraction.

formulas.title: Protocol Accounting
formulas.subtitle: Sooth V8.1 uses a Dual-Venue ledger with automated reconciliation.

items.name: Cash Basis Formula
items.desc: Reconciles every USDC in the AMM ledger. Gross Cash is the total pool of assets available to back trades and LP equity.

items.name: Equity Floor Formula
items.desc: The guaranteed minimum value of the pool. Liability is calculated as the cost to pay out the most probable outcome (max shares).

items.name: LP Valuation (ExRate)
items.desc: The real-time redemption value of 1 LP token. Unlike V7, V8 LP tokens are stakeholders in the entire AMM treasury.

items.name: Graduation Threshold
items.desc: Markets graduate to the SoothBook once cumulative trading fees reach 100% of the initial creator deposit (default graduationBps = 10000).

items.name: Creator Deposit
items.desc: Creator deposit = b × -ln(min(p, 1-p)). At 50/50 odds this simplifies to b × ln(2). Skewed initial odds increase the required deposit.
